label: Diagram C1
caption: Diagram C1 Overheating risk at postcode area level in the high risk part of London
description: This is a map of London, drawn as a single outline subdivided into many small polygonal postcode areas. The areas are shaded in one of two colours. A block of dark green covers the central core and extends westwards, while a surrounding ring of pale green fills the outer northern, eastern and southern fringes. A small legend box sits in the lower right corner, headed "Postcode area risk level", showing a dark green square labelled "High risk" above a pale green square labelled "Moderate risk". Thus the dark central and western areas denote high risk and the paler outer areas denote moderate risk. A white channel-shaped feature appears at the right-hand edge of the map, and a thin winding line, the river, runs through the central dark green area and meets this channel at the right edge. Along the bottom, a solid green banner carries the white text "Diagram C1 Overheating risk at postcode area level in the high risk part of London". No scale, north arrow or grid is shown.
